meta.source: wavelength-clone (React+Vite clone of the original marketing site; link omitted from this repo), documented from the actual src/ codebase

categories.SHELL: Persistent chrome rendered around every route by App.jsx — announcement bar, nav, footer, cookie banner.
categories.HERO: The above-the-fold intro block of a page: headline, supporting copy, primary CTA and/or hero art.
categories.PROOF: Social proof: customer/investor/company logos, testimonials, team affiliations.
categories.FEATURE: Product/platform capability blocks — feature grids, product overview, enterprise pitch.
categories.CONTENT: Long-form or listing content specific to a content type — article body, post grid, integration list, legal text.
categories.CTA: Standalone conversion sections whose only job is to drive a click (demo, careers, contact form).

shell.announcement-bar.description: Thin dismissible banner above the navbar (AnnouncementBar in Navbar.jsx).
shell.announcement-bar.scope: Rendered once in App.jsx above the navbar on every route.

shell.navbar.description: Sticky top navigation: logo, nav links, mobile menu, CTA button.
shell.navbar.scope: Rendered once in App.jsx on every route (remounted per-route via `key={pathname}` to reset the mobile menu).

shell.footer.description: Site footer: link columns, legal links, social links.
shell.footer.scope: Rendered once in App.jsx below <main> on every route.

shell.cookie-banner.description: Bottom cookie-consent banner, dismissible and persisted client-side.
shell.cookie-banner.scope: Rendered once in App.jsx on every route.

shell.page-lines.description: Decorative vertical guide lines overlaid on certain hero sections (PageLines in components/sub/shared.jsx).
shell.page-lines.scope: Listed as a template-level section only where App.jsx renders the fixed (global) variant — integrations, blog-index, blog-post, case-study, and not-found. On about and contact the same component is instead embedded locally, absolutely positioned inside the hero section markup itself (hero.about / hero.contact), so it isn't a separate top-level slot there; home and legal render neither variant.

hero.home.description: Home page hero: headline, subcopy, primary CTA, and animated Rive hero art (Hero.jsx).

hero.about.description: About page hero: 'Building for the revenue teams of tomorrow' headline, rotated photo pair, Explore Careers CTA (AboutHero in About.jsx).

hero.contact.description: Contact page hero: 'Contact Us' headline + intro copy, directly above the contact form.

hero.integrations.description: Integrations page hero: headline + animated horizontal-scrolling row of integration icon tiles (IntegrationsHero in Integrations.jsx).

hero.blogs-index.description: Blog index hero: 'Blog' headline + subcopy + one featured post card (the single item flagged listedOnIndex).

hero.blog-post.description: Blog post hero: fixed-height banner with author/date byline, title, excerpt, and post hero art (post.heroArt.svg).
hero.blog-post.scope: Only the blog-post template (/blogs/:slug), one per post.

hero.case-study.description: Case study hero (dark bg-ink): title, excerpt, cover image, track art image.
hero.case-study.scope: Only the case-study template (/case-study/:slug), one per case study.

hero.legal.description: Legal page hero (dark bg-ink): 'updated' date, document title.

proof.logo-strip.description: Row of customer/investor logos directly under the home hero (LogoStrip.jsx).

proof.our-mission.description: 'Our mission' narrative card with Rive-animated background tracks and corner stickers (Mission in About.jsx).

proof.our-values.description: 8-item 'Our Values' icon+title+body grid over a Rive-animated background (Values in About.jsx).

proof.the-team.description: 'The Team' grid of past-employer/investor logos (Team in About.jsx).

content.open-roles.description: 2-item open-roles list with title/body/location chips and a Learn More affordance (OpenRoles in About.jsx).
content.open-roles.scope: Only the about template (/about), section id="career".

content.contact-form.description: Contact form (Name/Email/Subject/Message fields, honeypot field, submit button with idle/loading/success/error states).

content.integrations-list.description: Searchable grid of integration cards, filtered client-side by name substring, with an empty-state illustration when no match (IntegrationsList in Integrations.jsx).

content.blog-grid.description: Grid of post cards for every entry in blogs.json (PostCard, includes the featured item again).

content.article-body.description: Shared long-form article renderer: table-of-contents sidebar with active-anchor tracking + rendered body blocks (Article in components/sub/Article.jsx).
content.article-body.scope: Both the blog-post and case-study templates.

content.blog-faq.description: FAQ accordion appended after every blog post body (BlogFaq in components/sub/Article.jsx).

content.related-case-studies.description: 3-card 'Related Case Studies' grid, selected via ITEMS.filter(i => i.slug !== slug).slice(2, 5).

content.legal-body.description: Rendered legal document body (headings/paragraphs/lists) from src/data/legal.js's structure-only blocks.

content.not-found.scope: Only the not-found template (/404, and any unmatched route, and as a fallback render inside BlogPost/CaseStudy when a slug doesn't resolve).

cta.ci-cta.description: Mid-article conversion banner (CiCta in components/sub/Ctas.jsx), shown once per article-bearing page.
cta.ci-cta.scope: Both the blog-post and case-study templates, directly after the article body.

cta.join.description: Shared closing 'Join'/demo CTA band (JoinCta in components/sub/Ctas.jsx) with per-route copy/padding presets from JOIN_COPY/JOIN_PAD.
cta.join.scope: Appears as the final section on about, blog-index, blog-post, case-study, and integrations templates (not on home, contact, legal, or not-found).

cta.closing.description: Home page's own closing CTA band (ClosingCta.jsx) — distinct component from the shared JoinCta used elsewhere.
